title: Emrys and the Weather
author: P. M. Amberdale
blurb: Lior Okonkwo, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
